subject: Security & compliance qualification: VPC / on-prem deployment info request
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@carepoint.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security & compliance qualification: VPC / on-prem deployment info request

Hi Marta — great to meet today, and thanks for the time walking through CarePoint's ingestion and latency needs. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can qualify the private deployment options (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped) ahead of the technical deep-dive: 

Summary of what we heard (from call):
- Model traffic will be restricted to internal CarePoint services; some calls will be routed from an EU region for regulatory customers.
- Data flows include PHI at rest and in transit for a subset of endpoints (billing/notes ingestion).
- Primary constraint is network isolation and ability to sign a BAA.

Action items / asks:
1) SOC 2: can you confirm CarePoint's current SOC 2 status (Type II, report available, or expected date)?
2) HIPAA / BAA: do you require a BAA from Redwood? Any standard procurement language we should expect?
3) GDPR / data residency: will any EU-hosted datasets require dedicated EU-only deployment or is contractual assurance sufficient?
4) Network diagram: could you share an example network diagram showing your proposed connectivity to a third-party inference cluster (NAT, egress controls, IP allowlist)? If you prefer, we can provide a template.

I attached our vendor security questionnaire (Redwood_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) to speed the intake; if you prefer to fill only the SOC2/BAA-related sections for now, that works.

Next steps we propose:
- You share any existing compliance artifacts you can (SOC 2 attestation, security profile PDF) and a procurement contact.
- We'll schedule a technical deep-dive with Karthik (infra architect) to go through connectivity, IP allowlist, and air-gapped requirements.

Proposed times for the deep-dive: Tue/Wed next week, 10:00–13:00 PT windows. Link to book is below if easier.

Thanks again — happy to coordinate timelines.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@carepoint.health>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@carepoint.health, Jose Ramirez <jose.ramirez@carepoint.health>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & compliance qualification: VPC / on-prem deployment info request

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and attachments below.

Responses:
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II in progress; current testing window completes 2026-10 and we expect a report by Q4 2026. We can provide interim control summaries and our last Type I report now.
- HIPAA/BAA: Yes — we require a BAA for any processing of PHI. Procurement will start the BAA review; I've cc'd procurement@carepoint.health.
- GDPR / data residency: Some customers require EU-only storage. We would need a dedicated EU-hosted deployment or contractual restrictions limiting processing to EU zones.

I attached our internal security profile (carepoint-security-profile.pdf) which includes a high-level network diagram and our baseline requirements. For third-party vendors we typically ask for a filled vendor questionnaire (the one you attached) plus an architecture diagram showing how traffic will be isolated.

Procurement (procurement@carepoint.health) will lead contractual items; Jose (cc'd) is our technical point for on-prem connectivity.

Thanks — happy to schedule the technical deep-dive. Tue 10–11 PT works for us.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Director, Information Security
CarePoint Health
marta.lopez@carepoint.health

Attachments: carepoint-security-profile.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@carepoint.health>, procurement@carepoint.health
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & compliance qualification: VPC / on-prem deployment info request

Marta — appreciate the quick responses and the security profile. Attaching a short private-deploy checklist that outlines the artifacts we typically need for a VPC/on-prem engagement (network ACLs, certificate rotation, KMS/HSM integration notes).

To make the upcoming technical deep-dive productive, I've created a shared drive folder with the following:
- Sample network diagram (Redwood sample on‑prem diagram)
- Private deployment checklist (redwood-onprem-deploy-checklist.pdf)
- Completed questionnaire template (a partially filled starting point)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-PrivateDeployChecklist
Booking link (if you want to pick a slot): https://app.hubspot.com/meetings/aditya_rao/redwood-deep-dive

Karthik, could you lead the deep-dive and run through network isolation, NAT/firewall requirements, and air-gap feasibility?

Marta / Jose — if you can place the SOC 2 Type I / interim summaries in the folder (or send directly), that will help our security team start the controls mapping.

Thanks,
Aditya

Attachments: redwood-onprem-deploy-checklist.pdf, Redwood_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@carepoint.health>, Jose Ramirez <jose.ramirez@carepoint.health>, procurement@carepoint.health
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & compliance qualification: VPC / on-prem deployment info request

Hi Marta / Jose — thanks for the profile and for looping procurement in. Per Aditya's note, happy to run the deep-dive. Proposed time: Tue 22 Jun 2026 at 10:00 PT (60 min). If that works, I'll send an invite and an agenda:

Agenda (draft):
- 15m: deployment options overview (hosted vs dedicated vs on-prem/air-gap)
- 20m: network & connectivity (IP allowlist, egress control, NAT, VPN vs Direct Connect)
- 15m: key controls & artifacts (SOC 2 evidence, BAA, KMS integration)
- 10m: open questions and next steps

Two asks before the meeting:
1) If you can upload the SOC 2 Type I / interim control summary to the Drive link that would be helpful.
2) If there are any strict firewall/NAT rules or jump-host requirements in your on-prem architecture, please send a network diagram or a short bullet list of constraints.

We can also walk through an air-gapped option if your compliance team requires complete isolation; note the tradeoffs (latency and operational overhead).

I'll await confirmation on the time and will follow up with an invite and the meeting technical checklist.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Infrastructure Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
